notes.title: Schrodinger's Patch and 30% off
notes.content:
[h2]This just in - Schro Sale has started![/h2]

Hey there, physics feline fans!
 
Freshly updated and patched, Schrodinger’s Cat And The Raiders Of The Lost Quark is 30% off on Steam from the 9th until the 18th of January!

Fixes for the latest version include but are definitely not limited to:

[b]Falling through walls[/b] - Science is fun, and falling through unbreakable walls isn't science - it's just weird. This should no longer be happening in the latest patch.

[b]Getting stuck on the homescreen[/b] - We received some reports of players getting stuck on the home screen after some very specific steps - this is now fixed!

[b]Door Guardian Zweig's love for charms[/b] - Zweig loves it when you release charms... Even when you don't have any. We've given him a stern talking to and he should no longer be asking you to release non-existent charms.

[b]Repeated Dialogues [/b] - as great as the dialogues are, sometimes you want to just move on and not hear them multiple times... Fret no more, dialogues should now only play once!

There's a bunch more fixes included in this patch, so the game should be a much smoother experience now!

Have fun!

notes.title: Birthday Update! 75% OFF
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Particle Zoo Visitors![/b][/h1]

[img=http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/619592173492191568/D7E327836A98B60C589BA28346651D31072CC351/]

[b]Schrödinger’s Cat is 1 year old today![/b]

To celebrate a year of the purple cat, we have two pieces of exciting news!

First up, Schrodingers Cat and the Raiders of the Lost Quark is on sale for a whopping 75% off for one week only. So now’s the perfect chance to visit the Particle Zoo, or invite your friends to join you! 

Next up, we’ve been reading through your comments in the forums and have updated the game with some fixes and additions:

•	Fixed Japanese and Korean locales crashing 
•	Fixed issue where multiple devices conflicted with controller input
•	Improved compatibility with newer gamepads
•	Added in AZERTY control scheme

Thanks for your continued support and enthusiasm for Schrödinger’s Cat and the Raiders of the Lost Quark!

Danny

notes.title: Update 1.03 - 40% OFF! Killing mice! Punching gluons! Better gliding!
notes.content:
[img=http://www.modvive.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/maxresdefault.jpg]

[h1]Good meow-row, fans of the feline![/h1]

Here's what we've dug up for you in the garden for Version 1.03:

[b]1) No more mouse![/b] The Main Menu & Options are now completely navigable with the controller or keys, which means the whole game is 100% mouse free! Just the way us cats like it. Bonus: we've put controller prompts in the display instead of just keys.

[b]2) Punching those gluons.[/b] How come sometimes the punches went right through them? Well, we think we've nailed that now, nailed it the way you can confidently nail those sacks of slime from today forward.  
Slabam!

[b]3) That Glider combo (B+U).[/b] Sucked, right? Yeah, I think maybe 1 in 20 people ever nailed that on the first try, and some never figure it out, everyone just runs right off the end into the green goo. However, now you stick to the platform and you can even change directions! It's pretty sweet. You should try it.

And some other stuff too:

- New green goo death animation - dying is even more fun than before!
- Some camera annoyances fixed, you probably won't even notice.
- Some map edits and bug fixes

Schrödinger’s Cat And The Raiders Of The Lost Quark is also 40% off on Steam as part of the Summer Sale - grab your ticket to the Particle Zoo here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/295490

notes.content:

I’m Kevin from Italic Pig, the developer of Schrödinger’s Cat and the Raiders of the Lost Quark. 

I’m here to tell you what’s coming next for physics’ favourite feline, as well as gather your thoughts and feedback for future tweaks to the game. You’ll hear much more from me in the coming weeks, so keep your [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/295490/discussions/1/613940477694289931/]fovea centralis peeled on the forums.[/url] I mean it.

For now - I'm crazy excited to let you know that update 1.01 is out now for [b]SCatRotLQ[/b]! Here's a quick low-down on the new stuff, for the full details (and to tell us what you think!) join us in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/295490/discussions/1/613940477694289931/]forums.[/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/295490/discussions/1/613940477694289931/]Grab the full details on 1.01 in the forums[/url], plus you can come and ask me anything you like. Unless it's about sports or fixing cars.
